tasks.goal: a zero-dependency Node HTTP JSON API for a wishlist: POST /wishes {title,priority 1-3} -> 201 {id} or 400 bad priority, GET /wishes -> 200 array sorted by priority, DELETE /wishes/:id -> 204 or 404. In-memory store. Also write test-api.js, an executable probe harness that boots the server itself on PORT=0, exercises every route including the 400 and the 404, and exits non-zero on any mismatch. Record verified probes in .atoma-probes.json (the harness as a shell entry). As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE: run the existing test script end-to-end via run_shell (node test-api.js) and confirm previously recorded probes still pass; the deliverable of that phase is the verified pass/fail outcome plus the probe-manifest update.

a zero-dependency Node HTTP JSON API for stock levels: PUT /stock/:sku {delta} -> 200 {sku,level} (level never below 0 -> 409 when it would go negative), GET /stock/:sku -> 200 or 404, GET /stock -> 200 object. In-memory. Also write test-api.js, an executable harness that boots the server itself (PORT=0), covers every route including the 409 and the 404, and exits non-zero on mismatch. Record verified probes in .atoma-probes.json (the harness as a shell entry). As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE: run the existing test script end-to-end via run_shell (node test-api.js) and confirm previously recorded probes still pass; the deliverable of that phase is the verified pass/fail outcome plus the probe-manifest update.
